t3.text: Collaboration, and the viewer with split view

s1.text: Every mark on this canvas is [P], proposed. Slides are the study's sample deck (synthetic content, the synthetic Northwind pack) exported by the prototype and drawn by LibreOffice. Plan: docs/design/duo-decks-study/plan.md on research/duo-decks.

s2.text: The viewer waits for split view (Geoff, 2026-10-31). Split view's study is the session split-view: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LhGdJWtnnUWeRUroZZDmyc. Duo Decks' requirements: docs/design/duo-decks-study/split-view-requirements.md. S1 to S3 get redrawn in split view's terms once it has its framing.

t4.text: Q-377 · Where does “make templates from these slides” start?

s3.text: Geoff asked for options on a canvas (2026-10-31). A is recommended: you choose slides by looking at them. C is A plus a menu that also holds Convert to Duo Deck (M3b) and a whole-deck pack, so it can come later as A grows. D works alongside any of them, because the verbs exist anyway. B suits pack upkeep more than first use.
